requirement.description: {requirements_reuben} asked for a formal review of the feature store before any model is trained on it. A reviewed feature store would ensure that the model only trains on compliant and secure data.
requirement.fact: {requirements_reuben} asked for a formal review of the feature store before any model is trained on it.
requirement.reading: A reviewed feature store would ensure that the model only trains on compliant and secure data.

author.name: Requirements Reuben
author.role: Architects secure and scalable production ML systems. Defines security requirements, ensures privacy compliance, and manages data governance. Conducts rigorous testing and validation to guarantee high product quality.

challenge.name: The Silent Store Gap
challenge.description: A batch of till scan lines from the northern stores was silently dropped during last night's ingestion, causing the model to forecast zero demand for fresh produce. #reliability_ruth# argues that the ingestion pipeline must be fully automated to guarantee every store's data arrives on time, while #data_dave# is willing to accept a manual verification step to ensure data quality before it reaches the feature store.

output.content: I need a formal review of the feature store before any model is trained on it. The current setup lacks the necessary controls to guarantee that only compliant and secure data reaches the training pipeline. I want a structured validation process in place. The more rigorous this review becomes, the better. I am looking for a system that catches privacy violations and security gaps before they impact the model. This is not a one time check. I want a continuous, automated verification layer that scales as we add new data sources. The goal is to ensure that every feature entering the store meets our strict governance standards. I am pushing for a higher standard of assurance here, and I expect the team to build that capability into the core workflow.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states that 'the more rigorous this review becomes, the better' and is 'pushing for a higher standard of assurance,' indicating that exceeding the baseline request for a formal review would make them happier.
